integrity: All anonymous profiles through five voters are enumerated, both rules are computed by two independent exact implementations, multinomially weighted counts are checked by separate direct labeled-profile enumeration, and all minimal conflicts are canonicalized under candidate relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exhaustive only for exactly three candidates and electorate sizes through five under complete strict ballots and parallel-universes tie-breaking. It concerns different singleton winner sets, not every possible set-valued disparity.
title: Sharp five-voter unique-winner disagreement between STV and Coombs runoff
